This product is supplied without battery and charger. 18V battery required (sold separately, see product code 124YM).

Erbauer EXT 18V angle grinder featuring V2 brushless motor to deliver up to 20% more power for tough grinding jobs than the previous model. Advanced electronic controls include soft start to ensure a smooth, controlled startup, and overload protection which shuts off automatically during excessive strain, extending the lifespan of the tool. Also features quick guard change, soft grip, ergonomic 3-position side handle, and spindle lock for effortless efficiency. Ideal for metalworkers, contractors, and DIY enthusiasts for professional results in cutting, grinding, fabrication and welding projects and surface preparation.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
